title: One New session button, and a dictate indicator you can see on every surface

chat.text: The surfaces page found the New session button built three times; the sheet and the AI tab now call the one in Dictate's chat, and what a new session does is written down with its URL. While the mic is open, the same level meter shows on the floating mic, the sheet and the drawer, and a small listening dot shows in the sidebar tab when the surface is collapsed. Proven with shots at 400 and 1200.
